description: Source publication calendar, dataset-specific availability, PIT, stage qualification and 4-state acceptance; authoritative rules for controller and ChatGPT query, not claims that every dataset is complete.

time_fields.effective_session: trading or snapshot date as relevant
time_fields.first_published_at: evidenced issuer or authority publication time
time_fields.available_at: first public time for exact version and source record; null if unverifiable
time_fields.downloaded_at: our observed acquisition time; NOT historical availability
time_fields.revised_at: later publication of corrected values, with separate version

eligibility.can_fetch: A record can be fetched when official endpoint exposes it, even before nominal deadline
eligibility.can_aggregate: Bronze raw complete and verified for exact dataset/date/symbol expected scope; partial allowed separately
eligibility.can_transform: Bronze source SHA+schema and release/pit metadata preserved; unit verified
eligibility.can_gold: Silver contract and all indicator dependencies certified; mark missing otherwise
eligibility.can_backtest: Every input has proven available_at <= historical_asof and correct asof vintage, no later revisions

acceptance_states.PASS: all expected applicable units obtained/quality and conversions/lineage/PIT certified
acceptance_states.PARTIAL: some applicable units available and valid but incomplete or unverified
acceptance_states.BLOCK: not yet published or gated for upstream, formula, approval, PIT

rmi.numerator: verified and applicable data-unit count with exact dataset version
rmi.denominator: officially expected and already published applicable data-unit count, excluding not-yet-due, non-trading and non-applicable
rmi.unknown: null if exact expected number unknown; folder count cannot serve as denominator
rmi.metric: 100 * numerator / denominator only if denominator and evidence available
rmi.pit_metric: independent % with proven first_published_at per historical asof
rmi.overdue: A release is not overdue without an authoritative due/release schedule or official evidence; early filings included immediately

sources.release_rule: After official market close AND exact dataset accessible; exchange calendar/holidays and product timestamps
sources.pit: actual verified official first publication per dataset

sources.release_rule: Product-dependent release windows, actual session and official response receipt; never assume all product tables at same time
Each issuer may file earlier; usual nominal due next month day 10; eligible insurer exceptions may be day 15 since 2026, verify per company
sources.pit: per company filing timestamp; September filing in October not available on Sep30

sources.release_rule: Determine issuer class, fiscal quarter, filing schedule and actual announcement; no generic monthly due assumption
Week-ending business-day snapshot is distinct from date of public access; confirm product release and public retention limits
sources.pit: earliest official week data publication evidence

sources.release_rule: Individual contracts / settlements / post-close and after-hours datasets have different release times
Use authority's announced economic indicator release calendar; snapshots/version preserved
sources.pit: announced release actual source evidence; later revision separate

sources.release_rule: Actual official calendar; do not infer period month is public
Official industrial-production release; subsequent revisions are distinct vintages

guardrails: Missing source-month folder != failed download if official publication not due
Source contract must match content, especially TDCC misfiled fund records
Market data money values display 億元; raw original unit retained with conversion evidence
Save emerging market but do not include in TSE/OTC Gold analysis
Do not infer first_published_at from downloaded_at
Never promote unvalidated native Gold numeric index as one of 443 calculated indicators
Do not advance before 2026-09 while pilot source coverage/QA/PIT is unverified

acceptance_pilot_202609_202611.meaning: Folders/partial Parquet exist. No full 443 indicator or formal PIT approval. Source-month observation not completeness.
